The subject of this sketch is, perhaps, the most original and variously gifted designer the world has ever known. arxiv-2112-11640.title: Self-Distillation Mixup Training for Non-autoregressive Neural Machine Translation
arxiv-2112-11640.creator: Jiaxin Guo, Minghan Wang, Daimeng Wei, Hengchao Shang, Yuxia Wang, Zongyao Li, Zhengzhe Yu, Zhanglin Wu, Yimeng Chen, Chang Su,, Min Zhang, Lizhi Lei, Shimin Tao, Hao Yang
arxiv-2112-11640.description: Abstract Recently, non-autoregressive (NAT) models predict outputs in parallel, achieving substantial improvements in generation speed compared to autoregressive (AT) models. While performing worse on raw data, most NAT models are trained as student models on distilled data generated by AT teacher models, which is known as sequence-level Knowledge Distillation.

arxiv-2203-05741.title: Numerical package for QFT calculations of defect-induced phenomena in graphene
arxiv-2203-05741.creator: Hillol Biswas, Harshitra Mahalingam, Aleksandr Rodin
arxiv-2203-05741.description: Abstract We introduce a computationally efficient method based on the path integral formalism to describe defect-modified graphene. By taking into account the entire Brillouin zone, our approach respects the lattice symmetry and can be used to investigate both short-range and long-range effects.

arxiv-2306-01613.title: Hyperparameter Learning under Data Poisoning: Analysis of the Influence of Regularization via Multiobjective Bilevel Optimization Thanks: P. Spencer is with the Defence Science and Technology Laboratory (Dstl), Porton Down, Salisbury, United Kingdom.
arxiv-2306-01613.creator: Javier Carnerero-Cano, Luis Muñoz-González, Phillippa Spencer, and Emil C. Lupu
arxiv-2306-01613.description: Abstract Machine Learning (ML) algorithms are vulnerable to poisoning attacks, where a fraction of the training data is manipulated to deliberately degrade the algorithms’ performance. Optimal attacks can be formulated as bilevel optimization problems and help to assess their robustness in worst-case scenarios.

arxiv-2311-10264.title: Dynamic Instability of Follower Forced Euler Bernoulli Cantilever Beam With Tip Mass
arxiv-2311-10264.creator: Premjit Saha, Tarunraj Singh
arxiv-2311-10264.description: Abstract This work focuses on the stability analysis of an Euler Bernoulli cantilever beam with a tip mass at the free end, subject to a follower force. This can serve as a viable model for analysis of elastic instability occurring due to fluid-structure interaction of structural components submerged in fluids and gases.

arxiv-2312-15347.title: On Safety and Liveness Filtering Using Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability Analysis
arxiv-2312-15347.creator: Javier Borquez, Kaustav Chakraborty, Hao Wang, Somil Bansal
arxiv-2312-15347.description: Abstract Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability-based filtering provides a powerful framework to co-optimize performance and safety (or liveness) for autonomous systems. Under this filtering scheme, a nominal controller is minimally modified to ensure system safety or liveness. However, the resulting controllers can exhibit abrupt switching and bang-bang behavior, which is not suitable for applications of autonomous systems in the real world.

arxiv-2401-03567.title: HYPERBOLIC DISTANCE-BASED SPEECH SEPARATION
arxiv-2401-03567.creator: Darius Petermann, Minje Kim \sthanks Work done at Indiana University
arxiv-2401-03567.description: Abstract In this work, we explore the task of hierarchical distance-based speech separation defined on a hyperbolic manifold. Based on the recent advent of audio-related tasks performed in non-Euclidean spaces, we propose to make use of the Poincaré ball to effectively unveil the inherent hierarchical structure found in complex speaker mixtures.

arxiv-2502-10868.title: NitiBench: A Comprehensive Study of LLM Framework Capabilities for Thai Legal Question Answering
arxiv-2502-10868.creator: Pawitsapak Akarajaradwong †, Pirat Pothavorn †, Chompakorn Chaksangchaichot †, Panuthep Tasawong, Thitiwat Nopparatbundit, Keerakiat Pratai, Sarana Nutanong
arxiv-2502-10868.description: Abstract The application of large language models (LLMs) in the legal domain holds significant potential for information retrieval and question answering, yet Thai legal QA systems face challenges due to a lack of standardized evaluation benchmarks and the complexity of Thai legal structures.

arxiv-2506-12039.title: The Maximal Overlap Discrete Wavelet Scattering Transform and Its Application in Classification Tasks
arxiv-2506-12039.creator: Leonardo Fonseca Larrubia leonardo.larrubia@usp.br, Pedro Alberto Morettin pam@ime.usp.br, Chang Chiann chang@ime.usp.br
arxiv-2506-12039.description: Abstract We present the Maximal Overlap Discrete Wavelet Scattering Transform (MODWST), whose construction is inspired by the combination of the Maximal Overlap Discrete Wavelet Transform (MODWT) and the Scattering Wavelet Transform (WST). We also discuss the use of MODWST in classification tasks, evaluating its performance in two applications: stationary signal classification and ECG signal classification.

arxiv-2506-23138.title: VisualPrompter: Prompt Optimization with Visual Feedback for Text-to-Image Synthesis
arxiv-2506-23138.creator: Shiyu Wu, Mingzhen Sun, Weining Wang, Yequan Wang, Jing Liu
arxiv-2506-23138.description: Abstract Since there exists a notable gap between user-provided and model-preferred prompts, generating high-quality and satisfactory images using diffusion models often requires prompt engineering to optimize user inputs. Current studies on text-to-image prompt engineering can effectively enhance the style and aesthetics of generated images.

arxiv-2508-05781.title: Data-driven dust inference at mid-to-high Galactic latitudes using probabilistic machine learning 2025 Data-driven dust inference at mid-to-high Galactic latitudes using probabilistic machine learning – A
arxiv-2508-05781.creator: Matthew O’Callaghan, Kaisey S. Mandel, Gerry Gilmore
arxiv-2508-05781.description: Abstract We present a method for accurately and precisely inferring photometric dust extinction towards stars at mid-to-high Galactic latitudes ( | b | > 20 ∘ |b|>20^{\circ} ), using probabilistic machine learning to model the colour–magnitude distribution of zero-extinction stars in these regions. Photometric dust maps rely on a robust method for inferring stellar reddening.

arxiv-2510-13165.title: The local well-posedness, global existence and ill-posedness for the fifth order Camassa-Holm model
arxiv-2510-13165.creator: Xiaoxin Chen, Zhaoyang Yin
arxiv-2510-13165.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xiaoxin Chen, Zhaoyang Yin. In this paper, we consider the fifth order Camassa-Holm model. Firstly, we improve the local well-posedness results in [ 34 , 38 ] . Secondly, we give the blow up criteria and conditions for global existence.

arxiv-2511-11052.title: AdaptPNP: Integrating Prehensile and Non-Prehensile Skills for Adaptive Robotic Manipulation Thanks: * Equal Contribution
arxiv-2511-11052.creator: Jinxuan Zhu, Chenrui Tie, Xinyi Cao, Yuran Wang, Jingxiang Guo, Zixuan Chen, Haonan Chen, Junting Chen, Yangyu Xiao, Ruihai Wu, Lin Shao
arxiv-2511-11052.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jinxuan Zhu, Chenrui Tie, Xinyi Cao, Yuran Wang, Jingxiang Guo, Zixuan Chen, Haonan Chen, Junting Chen, Yangyu Xiao, Ruihai Wu, Lin Shao. Non-prehensile (NP) manipulation, in which robots alter object states without forming stable grasps (for example, pushing, poking, or sliding), significantly broadens robotic manipulation capabilities when grasping is infeasible or insufficient.

arxiv-2602-08170.title: Evasion of IoT Malware Detection via Dummy Code Injection
arxiv-2602-08170.creator: Sahar Zargarzadeh, Mohammad A. Islam
arxiv-2602-08170.description: Abstract The Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized connectivity by linking billions of devices worldwide. However, this rapid expansion has also introduced severe security vulnerabilities, making IoT devices attractive targets for malware such as the Mirai botnet. Power side-channel analysis has recently emerged as a promising technique for detecting malware activity based on device power consumption patterns.

arxiv-2605-13681.title: Sampling from Flow Language Models via Marginal-Conditioned Bridges
arxiv-2605-13681.creator: Iskander Azangulov, Leo Zhang

pmc-10552570.title: Retinal transcriptome profiling identifies novel candidate genes associated with visual impairment in a mouse model of multiple sclerosis
pmc-10552570.creator: Sungmoo Hong, Poornima D E Weerasinghe-Mudiyanselage, Sohi Kang, Changjong Moon, Taekyun Shin
pmc-10552570.description: Visual impairment is occasionally observed in multiple sclerosis (MS) and its animal model, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE). Although uveitis and optic neuritis have been reported in MS and EAE, the precise mechanisms underlying the pathogenesis of these visual impairments remain poorly understood.

pmc-10745576.title: The Role of MWCNTs in Enhancing the Foam Stability and Rheological Behavior of Cement Pastes That Contain Air-Entraining and Superplasticizer Admixtures
pmc-10745576.creator: Ina Pundienė, Jolanta Pranckevičienė, Jakob Birkedal Wagner
pmc-10745576.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This research delves into the intricate dynamics between multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs), air-entraining admixtures (AEAs), and a range of superplasticizers (SPs) in cementitious systems, shedding light on key aspects of construction material innovation. The focus is on how MWCNTs, AEAs, and specific SPs—namely, lignosulfonate (LS), polycarboxylate (PCE), and polyacrylate (PA)—influence the stability of foams and the viscosity and setting times of cement pastes.

pmc-11442230.title: Polyvalvular Dysplasia and Vascular Abnormalities in a Neonate With an FLNA Variant
pmc-11442230.creator: Amy Frenkel, Max Frenkel, Jefree J Schulte, Shardha Srinivasan, Luke Lamers
pmc-11442230.description: There is growing appreciation for inherited structural heart diseases and their genetic causes. One causal gene for congenital cardiac and vascular lesions is FLNA which encodes a critical protein for cytoskeletal and extracellular matrix development. A newborn infant male, with prenatally diagnosed polyvalvular dysfunction, presented with low cardiac output and postnatally detected aortic arch hypoplasia and coarctation.

pmc-12595542.title: Kinetic Analysis of HDAC‐ and Sirtuin‐Mediated Deacylation on Chemically Defined Histones and Nucleosomes
pmc-12595542.creator: Zhuoyi L Niu, Ling Zhang, Yuan‐Fei Zhou, Zhipeng A Wang
pmc-12595542.description: Histone deacetylases (HDACs) and sirtuins (SIRTs) play essential roles in regulating chromatin structure and gene expression by catalyzing the removal of acyl groups from histone lysine residues. Accurate characterization of their deacetylation kinetics is critical for understanding their enzymatic mechanisms and for guiding inhibitor or activator development.

pmc-12649616.title: Evaluating the Diagnostic Performance of Long-Read Metagenomic Sequencing Compared to Culture and Antimicrobial Susceptibility Testing for Detection of Bovine Respiratory Bacteria and Indicators of Antimicrobial Resistance
pmc-12649616.creator: Jennifer N Abi Younes, Lianne McLeod, Simon J G Otto, Zhijian Chai, Stacey Lacoste, E Luke McCarthy, Matthew G Links, Emily K Herman, Paul Stothard, Sheryl P Gow, John R Campbell, Cheryl L Waldner, Degi Janos, Tiana Florea, Ilie Stelian
pmc-12649616.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Long-read metagenomic sequencing can detect bacteria and antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs) from bovine respiratory samples, providing an alternative to culture and antimicrobial susceptibility testing (C/S). This study applied Bayesian latent class models (BLCMs) to estimate the sensitivity (Se) and specificity (Sp) of long-read metagenomic sequencing compared to C/S for detecting Mannheimia haemolytica, Pasteurella multocida, and Histophilus somni, as well as associated macrolide and tetracycline resistance potential.

pmc-13018402.title: Maternal obesity and its impact on pregnancy
pmc-13018402.creator: Shambhavi Soni, Himanshy Rai, Mohita Pandey, Abhishek Mehta
pmc-13018402.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Maternal obesity is associated with a significantly increased risk of complications across all stages of pregnancy. Implementing targeted interventions can help mitigate obesity-related risks and improve overall pregnancy outcomes. Hence, a cross-sectional study was conducted from September 2022 to September 2023 at a tertiary care hospital of Central India to assess the prevalence of obesity among pregnant women and to evaluate its impact on pregnancy complications, mode of delivery and fetal outcomes.

pmc-13071502.title: Critical analysis of pemphigus vulgaris in pregnancy
pmc-13071502.creator: Tithi Shah, Alidzhon Baltabaev, Yisong Geng, A. Razzaque Ahmed
pmc-13071502.description: Human pregnancy is a complex, interesting and challenging interplay between the hormonal and immune systems. The presence of an autoimmune disease adds to this complexity. Presence of pemphigus vulgaris (PV) in a pregnant patient should be considered a "high risk pregnancy", by all health care providers involved, from implantation to post-partum care and thereafter.
